The platform guard at f2:6 encloses the browser-target guard at f2:91, and the region at f2:92-94 is inside both then arms. These two cited conditions therefore combine with AND and require both conditions.

The first witness hop, the CreateShortcut binding at f2:87, precedes the browser decision and lies outside the claimed region at f2:92-94. It therefore cannot be the first hop reached from that region, even though the region sets the state that subsequently selects Save().

The only Save() site is inside the platform then arm and runs when the inner state equals 60921; the only assignment of that state is in the browser-target then arm at f2:93. Each shortcut iteration initializes the state to 86892, and no other caller or entry point reaches this Save() site.

Dispatch is imported from win32com.client and constructs WScript.Shell, whose CreateShortcut result is the object receiving Save(). Saving its modified extension-loading Arguments to shortcuts found in Start Menu, pinned taskbar and Desktop folders provides persistent browser launch modification.
